title: Project Manager
description:
**ARB Accessories Pvt. Ltd. | Full-Time | Technology / Digital Transformation**

**Role Overview:** We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead our B2B e-commerce and ERP development initiatives. Our frontend is built on React / React Native and the backend ERP is ERP Next / Frappe. The role will manage in-house developers, third-party vendors, business stakeholders and end users to deliver scalable, user-friendly software solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Own projects end-to-end: requirement gathering, planning, sprint execution, testing, UAT, release and post-launch improvement.

· Manage Agile/Scrum ceremonies, product backlog, priorities, milestones, dependencies, risks and delivery timelines.

· Work with management, sales, purchase, warehouse, finance, support, customers and other stakeholders to gather and validate business requirements.

· Prepare BRD/FRD, user stories, use cases, process flows, acceptance criteria, UAT scenarios and change requests.

· Manage and coordinate in-house developers, frontend/backend teams and third-party software vendors.

· Validate business use cases, edge cases and workflow impact before development; ensure delivered features solve the actual business problem.

· Coordinate API and third-party integrations such as payment gateways, logistics, notifications and other SaaS platforms.

**Required Experience & Skills**

· 5+ years of software / IT project management experience, preferably in e-commerce, ERP or enterprise applications.

· Strong practical knowledge of Agile/Scrum, sprint planning, backlog management, stakeholder management and release management.

· Strong B2B e-commerce domain understanding: quotation, pricing, MOQ/UOM, customer-specific pricing, credit, payment terms, inventory, multi-warehouse, fulfilment, shipping and returns.

· Good ERP knowledge; hands-on experience with ERPNext/Frappe is a strong advantage.

· Working understanding of React, React Native, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks and frontend/backend integrations.

· Strong communication, documentation, problem-solving and team/vendor management skills.

**Ideal Candidate**

A business-oriented technology Project Manager who can move comfortably between management meetings, customer discussions, warehouse/operations teams and developer reviews. The candidate should convert business problems into clear, validated and executable software requirements—not just track tasks and meeting schedules.

**Preferred Domain: B2B E-Commerce + ERP + Supply Chain | Tech Stack: React / React Native / ERPNext / Frappe**

title: Lead Project Management Specialist- Project Controls
description:
This role is to provide Project Controls which includes schedule and cost controlling on projects. This role is for Project Controllers who are responsible for both cost and schedule on projects and or larger projects. In Project Controls, our goal is to ensure the right rigor around schedule and cost management processes to deliver projects on-time and within budget. With focus and rigor around tools, processes, operating rhythm, and people, here you shall have the opportunity to learn, contribute and excel in one of the best Project controls functions in the industry. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you’ll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition.

**Job Description**
===================

**Responsibilities & Accountabilities**

**Overall**

* Builds tender integrated schedules and cost estimates
* Build project schedule and project budgeting in cost and schedule tools
* Ensures compliance to the Global Standard process for Project Controls
* Support PM to align project budgets to as sold in appropriate systems
* Maintain project schedule and cost forecast throughout project
* Analyse schedule and cost trends and provide forecasted cost and schedules to project team
* Maintain a register of potential schedule and cost risks
* Maintain a register of actual and committed costs
* Checks and controls cost movements, compares with current scope and progress as well as with previous forecast. Also Compares with productivity factors and validates accuracy of estimates
* Communicates schedule and cost status/forecasts/risk to functional cost owners and drives/supports risk mitigation
* Provides internal and external project reporting of project status
* Collaborate with 3rd parties on project cost and schedules
* Presents all financial data in a transparent way, attends project and management review to present cost status
* Provides change order calculations to ensure schedule and cost estimates are accurate
* Updates changes in appropriate systems to ensure costs are aligned to the current situation
* Aligns with Finance Controller to ensure reconciliation takes place between approved project financial data and books
* Support project close out and claims
* Provide support to tenders
* Oversee the planning function on the project
* Ensure quality of the project controlling reporting.

title: Senior Project Manager HVDC
description:
The Senior Project Manager – HVDC is responsible for leading the execution of large, complex High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) projects from contract award through commissioning and closeout. This role has full accountability for project performance across safety, quality, schedule, cost, risk, and customer satisfaction. The Senior Project Manager coordinates multidisciplinary teams including engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, commercial, and contract management functions to ensure successful project delivery in line with company objectives and contractual commitments and will report to the Project Director.
**Job Description**
===================


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Project Leadership and Execution


* Lead with team end\-to\-end execution of HVDC projects, ensuring delivery in accordance with contract requirements, budget, schedule, and quality standards.
* Partner with Project Director to establish project execution strategy, governance, and delivery plans.
* Drive project performance across all phases including engineering, procurement, manufacturing, installation, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Ensure alignment between project scope, execution methodology, and customer expectations.
* Manage internal and external project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Provide leadership to cross\-functional and geographically dispersed project teams.

2\. Commercial and Financial Management


* Along with Project Director take ownership of project P\&L, cost control, margin protection, cash flow, and financial forecasting.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, contingencies, and billing milestones.
* Identify and manage changes in scope, claims, variation orders, and contractual entitlements.
* Ensure robust contract/commercial management in cooperation with finance, commercial, and contract management teams.
* Drive opportunities for cost optimization and operational efficiency.

3\. Schedule and Resource Management


* Support to develop and maintain integrated project schedules and key milestone plans.
* Support \& ensure appropriate allocation of project resources across engineering, supply chain, site execution, and commissioning activities.
* Monitor schedule progress and implement recovery plans when needed.
* Coordinate with functional managers to secure the required competencies and capacities for successful project delivery.

4\. Risk and Opportunity Management


* Lead identification, assessment, and mitigation of project risks and opportunities.
* Maintain project risk registers and ensure timely implementation of mitigation actions.
* Anticipate project execution challenges related to technology, interfaces, supply chain, construction, grid connection, and regulatory requirements.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately and propose practical solutions.

5\. Customer and Stakeholder Management


* Serve as the primary point of contact for the customer on all project execution matters.
* Build strong customer relationships and ensure high levels of satisfaction and trust.
* Lead customer meetings, project reviews, progress reporting, and executive\-level communications.
* Manage interfaces with consortium partners, subcontractors, suppliers, utilities, consultants, and regulatory authorities as applicable.

6\. Contract and Claims Management


* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and project governance requirements.
* Support interpretation of contract terms, management of obligations, and administration of key notices.
* Lead or support preparation and negotiation of claims, extensions of time, and change requests.
* Work closely with legal and contract management teams to protect company interests.

7\. Quality, Safety, and Compliance


* Promote and enforce a strong culture of **EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety)** across all project activities.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, customer specifications, industry regulations, and applicable standards.
* Drive quality assurance and quality control throughout project execution.
* Ensure project lessons learned are captured and applied.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in **Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering,** or related discipline.
* Master’s degree is an advantage.
* Project Management certification such as **PMP, IPMA, or equivalent** is preferred.

### **Experience**


* **15\+ years** of experience in project management, with significant experience in Large Infrastructure projects in the field of Transmission, Generation or O\&G. Experience in **HVDC, FACTS technologies** will be an added advantage**.**
* Proven track record of successfully delivering large, complex, multidisciplinary projects of \> $100 M.
* Must have experience of working on global contracts (in multiple geographies) and hands on experience of partnering \& working with global teams from various countries and cultures.
* Strong experience in managing customer contracts, project financials, risks, and claims.
* Experience in international project environments and matrix organizations preferred.
* Experience with utility, transmission system operator (TSO), or grid projects is highly desirable.

### **Required Skills**


* Understanding of **HVDC systems**, power transmission projects, and large infrastructure delivery.
* Excellent project management capabilities across scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and stakeholder management.
* Strong technical, commercial and contractual acumen.
* Leadership skills with the ability to manage large cross\-functional teams.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills.
* Proficiency with project planning, reporting, and financial management tools.
* Familiarity with EPC contract models and consortium project execution.
* Ability to manage multicultural and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong presentation and executive reporting skills.

**Additional Information**
==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes
